evidence_items.explanation: Material counterevidence to a broad claim that comparable AI service is not becoming cheaper. The multi-year benchmark-price result neither isolates the selected Q1 observation nor measures the companies' full production costs or the causal effect of data-center expansion.

Anthropic reports a later reduction in inference-compute requirements, challenging an unrestricted claim of no efficiency improvement. This is company-reported, postdates the historical component, and does not establish full-company profitability.

unresolved_gaps: No decisive causal evidence establishes the forecast effects of additional data centers or funding.
The retrieved cost evidence does not isolate comparable provider costs during the selected historical quarter.
Customer willingness to cover full costs is not measured by falling API prices.
No deadline or specified accounting basis permits a final financial score.
